conjecture: T2 (Neil UID 124, 'do T2 generally'): for which closed symmetric monoidal C with small coproducts is the Dirichlet/convolution tensor (S,P)(x)(T,Q)=(SxT,(P_s(x)Q_t)) on Fam(C^op) CLOSED, i.e. does (-)⊗(T,Q) have a right adjoint (internal hom) inside Fam(C^op)? RESULT: closedness <=> the functor Phi(Z)=prod_{t in T} coprod_{r in R} C(M_r, Z(x)Q_t) : C->Set is FAMILIALLY REPRESENTABLE (a small coproduct of corepresentables) for all families, equivalently Theta_{A,Q}(Z)=prod_t C(A_t,Z(x)Q_t) fam-rep for all families. Two conjuncts: (A) single-factor Z|->C(A,Z(x)Q) fam-rep; (B) product-closure: the coproduct coprod_t N_t representing prod_t exists in C. TWO sufficient regimes with explicit internal homs: (I) C cartesian closed => closed unconditionally (internal hom = coprod_{rho:T->R} prod_t C(M_{rho t},Q_t) shapes, positions coprod_t M_{rho t}); recovers Set/Poly Dirichlet hom (Niu-Spivak Ex 4.78). (II) all Q_t dualizable + coproducts exist => closed (internal hom = (R^T,(coprod_t M_{rho t}(x)Q_t^*)_rho)). LINEAR DICHOTOMY (Thm 3.2): over Vec single-factor fam-rep <=> Q finite-dim (Lemma 3.1); so (x) is closed on Fam_fin(Vec_fd^op) [finite shapes, fd positions] but NOT on Fam(Vec_fd^op) [infinite shapes break (B): Phi(Z)=|Z|^N=Vec(k^(N),Z) needs infinite-dim representative] NOR on Fam(Vec^op) [infinite-dim positions break (A) by Lemma 3.1]. Load-bearing conjunct NAMED: simultaneous dualizable-and-summable coprod_t M_{rho t}(x)Q_t^* in C, satisfiable over Vec only on the finite/fd corner. CORRECTS the pre-registered prediction ('holds over full Vec, fails over Vec_fd') -- fails over BOTH by dual mechanisms.

Only the tensor-argument positions Q_t need duals; the representing object N_rho need not be dualizable (Rem 2.4) -- the asymmetry that drives the linear collision.

Lemma 3.1: over Vec, Z|->Vec(A,Z(x)Q) familially representable <=> dim Q < infinity (dualizable), then corepresentable at A(x)Q^*. Necessity: A=k gives |Z(x)Q|; Phi(0)=1 forces single corepresentable; for Q=k^(I) infinite, Z|->|coprod_I Z| fails to preserve an infinite product (element with distinct I-coordinates has no finite-support preimage) => not corepresentable => not fam-rep.

Thm 3.2 (THE DELIVERABLE): (x) closed on Fam_fin(Vec_fd^op) [both conjuncts hold: fd=>dualizable (A), finite T => finite (+) stays fd (B)]; NOT closed on Fam(Vec_fd^op) [conjunct B fails: witness T=N,Q_t=k,R={r},M=k gives Phi(Z)=|Z|^N=Vec(k^(N),Z), representative k^(N) infinite-dim not in Vec_fd]; NOT closed on Fam(Vec^op) [conjunct A fails by Lemma 3.1: witness Q=k^(N)]. Load-bearing conjunct NAMED: simultaneous dualizable-and-summable coprod_t M_{rho t}(x)Q_t^* in C. Corrects PROVE.md prediction: fails over BOTH by dual mechanisms (cocompleteness over Vec_fd, dualizability over Vec).

Prop 4.1: T2 closedness obstruction is LOGICALLY DISTINCT from the T1 fullness/extensivity gap (coprod^Set ⊊ (+)). T1 = |-| fails to preserve (+), a property of the UNIT, insensitive to fd-ness. T2 = cocompleteness failure (over Vec_fd) or dualizability failure (over Vec), properties of the CATEGORY / MONOIDAL structure. Same origin (external shapes / internal positions) two seams: extensivity governs fullness, dualizable-summability governs closedness. Not a reduction.
